one_month_reasoning: The window (to 2026-11-01) contains the Q3 2026 print. The date is not yet announced, but all 23 earnings 8-Ks since 2021 were filed on a Monday in the last week of the reporting month or the first days of the next, so Oct 26 or 27 is the likely date and the print is almost certainly inside the window. The Oct 27-28 FOMC also falls in it (Polymarket, 2026 event slug fed-decision-in-october-20260617190323537: ~82.5% hold / ~17.5% +25bp, $24.2M volume, read 2026-10-02). The $100M ASR was expected to finish by the end of Q3 (8-K 2026-08-05), so that bid has most likely ended, and the stock is up ~39% from the $80.39 close on Sep 14. The supervisor stresses that the last four prints fell 9-21% the next day. I computed the longer base rate from EDGAR 8-K dates and Twelve Data closes: across 23 prints since 2021, 11 fell the next day, the median move was +2.0%, the mean was -1.4% and the mean absolute move was 8.5%. For the 8 prints that followed a 15-day run-up of more than 9%, 4 fell and the mean was about -3%. The recent losing streak is real but comes from a small sample, so I tilt only modestly: median ~$111 (just under spot) with a monthly log sigma of 0.18, which reflects the earnings gap risk.

fair_value.method: 28x NTM non-GAAP EPS at Oct-2027 of ~$4.00 = $112 (60%). 2028E FCF ~$377M at a 3.5% yield plus ~$0.75B net cash over ~108M shares = $107 (30%). Spot grown by RMBS's 20-year median 12-month return of +10% = $123 (10%). The blend is ~$112.

inputs_detail.derivation: stockanalysis 2026 consensus. It matches Q1 $0.63 + Q2 $0.77 + Q3 guide midpoint $0.785 plus a similar Q4.

Built bottom-up as 2026E $3.04 x 1.18. Baird expects RDIMM units +12-15% in 2027, and the shift to 32/64GB modules (TrendForce) lets units outgrow the 15-20% bit supply. Add MRDIMM/companion-chip content and a slight margin lever. I no longer use the unverified $3.72 consensus, which is paywalled, except as an upper bound.
FY27 $3.59 x 1.15. Growth slows as MRDIMM ramps on Diamond Rapids and Venice but the supply cap persists.

Forward P/E has ranged from ~24x (July 2026 trough) to ~44x (Aug 2026); the 12-month average P/E is ~41x. With growth slowing to the mid-teens and the DOJ overhang, I put it near the low third of the range.

methods.inputs: 2028E FCF $377M / 3.5% = $10.8B, plus $0.75B net cash, over 108M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: H1 2026 OCF of $144.5M (after a $30.7M inventory build) less $20.7M capex = $123.8M FCF. Annualized with some inventory normalization, that is ~$285M.
$285M grown ~15% a year for two years, in line with the EPS path.

This is the inverse of a ~28x FCF multiple, consistent with the P/E leg. It is set slightly above a 3.25% yield because H1 2026 also paid $52.7M of taxes on net share settlement, a recurring cash cost that FCF omits.

bear.story: Q3/Q4 prints extend the run of post-earnings selloffs. 2027 unit growth undershoots Baird's 12-15% (MRDIMM slips further with Diamond Rapids, or a hyperscaler pause), royalties step down, and 2027 EPS lands near $3.1-3.2. A DOJ development or a hawkish Fed compresses the multiple to ~18-20x NTM, and the stock revisits and breaks the $77.89/$80.39 lows.

base.story: Rambus delivers mid/high-teens EPS growth (FY27 ~$3.6, FY28 ~$4.1). RDIMM units still grow because smaller modules mean more RCDs per bit. The DOJ probe stays quiet, and the stock trades at ~28-30x NTM EPS of ~$4.00 with typical RMBS swings.

bull.story: AMD Venice and then Diamond Rapids drive MRDIMM and companion-chip content, FY27 EPS reaches the $3.72+ consensus or higher, and the multiple returns to ~40x as seen in Aug 2026. The stock retakes the area of the $174 June 2026 high.

thesis_break_reason: $70 is ~10% below the $77.89 March 2026 low and the $80.39 Sep-14 close, and ~17.5x my NTM EPS of ~$4.00 at the horizon. That is a multiple RMBS has not traded at since its AI re-rating, and the stock did not reach it through the April -21% print or the June DOJ/sector selloff. A sustained trade there would most likely mean earnings are being cut: RDIMM units actually contracting, share loss in RCD/PMIC, a royalty-renewal shortfall, or a DOJ indictment or forced change to licensing practices. I keep $70 rather than the supervisor's $72; the gap is within noise, and $70 sits more clearly outside the 2026 trading range.

reasoning: The anchor is unchanged from round 1. RMBS's 20-year 12-month log-return sd is ~0.45, the median 12-month return is +10%, and P(>=2x) is ~7%. Cases more than 25% below the trailing high show mean reversion with fat tails. I use sigma 0.50 for 12 months, between the long-run figure and the 80% 2026 realized vol. Round-2 corrections from the supervisor: (1) the $3.72 FY27 consensus is paywalled and unverified, so I rebuilt EPS bottom-up (FY27 $3.59, FY28 $4.13) and used the correct Oct-2027 NTM weighting (1/4 FY27 + 3/4 FY28 = $4.00) instead of full 2028E $4.40; (2) I dropped the target-haircut leg and replaced it with a small base-rate drift leg and a FCF-yield leg on the 10-Q H1 FCF base; (3) the ASR is complete, so it is no longer a support catalyst; (4) TrendForce's figure is bit supply and modules are shrinking, which makes unit contraction less likely and offsets part of the fair-value cut. Fair value falls from $118 to $112, about spot. With the historical +10% median drift given partial weight, I set the 12-month median at ~$114 (round 1: $116). The ladder is a lognormal (median 114, sigma 0.50) with the 2x+ tail trimmed toward the empirical 7% and a slightly fatter far-left tail for the DOJ and concentration risks (two customers are ~38-40% of revenue). The scenario mean is ~$118.5. For the 1-month ladder I added the earnings-reaction base rate the supervisor asked for, computed over 23 prints since 2021 (EDGAR 2.02 8-K dates and Twelve Data closes). It shows a coin flip on direction with an 8.5% average absolute move, so I tilt only ~1% below spot rather than the supervisor's ~2 points. Research was limited to EDGAR and Twelve Data calls in this round; the Twelve Data earnings endpoint was paywalled.
